question: What analogy explains why gross elements are not seen separately in Rudra bodies?
premises: In gold, earth particles are not seen separately because its fiery nature predominates.
A similar condition applies to what is present in the bodies of higher and lower Rudras.
inference: Gross constituents remain present but are not separately manifest because a subtler dominant nature overwhelms them.
plain_english: Just as earth particles in gold do not appear separately because its fiery nature predominates, so too the elements in the bodies of the higher and lower Rudras do not appear separately.
